about.title: About Clayton County Public Schools
about.content: Clayton County Public Schools serves students in Clayton County, Georgia, including Jonesboro and south metro Atlanta communities. The district calendar lists the first and last school days, fall break, Thanksgiving break, semester break, winter break when scheduled, spring break, ELBC days, professional learning days, and major holidays.

about.title: District Calendar and School-Level Schedules
about.content: This districtwide calendar is a starting point for family planning. Families should still check their assigned school for bell schedules, testing, athletics, graduation, transportation notices, program events, and emergency schedule changes.

planningTips.title: Clayton County Calendar Notes
content: ELBC means Extended Learning Beyond the Classroom. The district describes ELBC days as virtual instructional days for students and planning or professional development days for teachers.
PL Day is a Professional Learning Day. When it appears on the student calendar as a workday, families should not treat it as a regular student attendance day.
Clayton County uses Semester Break for the late-December break and may list a separate February Winter Break in some school years.
Election Day can also be an ELBC day, so families should check whether the date is virtual instruction rather than a normal in-person day.

districtFaqs.q: What does ELBC mean on the Clayton County Public Schools calendar?
districtFaqs.a: ELBC means Extended Learning Beyond the Classroom. The district describes ELBC days as virtual instructional days for students and planning or professional development days for teachers.

districtFaqs.q: What is a PL Day on the Clayton County calendar?
districtFaqs.a: PL Day means Professional Learning Day. On the student calendar, a PL Day / Workday is a staff-focused date rather than a normal student attendance day.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Clayton County Public Schools calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Clayton County Public Schools school-year calendars page and the district PDF for final confirmation before making travel, childcare, or school-specific plans.
